title: cytisus eriocarpus subsp. tmoleus
intro: Cytisus eriocarpus subsp. tmoleus, commonly known as Spanish broom, is a shrub-like plant native to the Iberian Peninsula. It is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to support cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spanish broom include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Spanish broom on human health and its potential therapeutic applications.
